name: Oregon State University
description:
Oregon State University is a public research university in Corvallis, Oregon. It proudly has the 10th largest engineering college in the nation for 2022 and attracts around 4,000 international students from over 95 countries yearly.

International students are well-supported among a diverse student population. The land-grant University offers over 200 undergraduate degree programs.

What is the Oregon State University acceptance rate for International Students?

The Oregon State University acceptance rate is 82%.

The Student Recreation Center has basketball courts, an indoor track, a swimming pool, weight and cardio rooms, a climbing wall, and lots more.

The Fairbanks Gallery, the Memorial Union Gallery, and the Majestic Theatre provide arts and entertainment to students between studies.

Student Life

Oregon State University has a distinctive 400+ student clubs representing vast interests. Students are passionate about creating a unified fun atmosphere and embracing other cultures. Athletics is a big part of campus life as there is a women's rowing team, baseball team, and more student sports clubs to join or support from the stands. Workshops and seminars are hosted throughout the year to keep students engaged and active in all aspects of campus life. First-year students who live in residence halls tend to earn higher grades than those who live off campus.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Most first-year students choose to live on campus in one of the 16 residence halls the University has to offer. These halls house over 6,000 students. All rooms are provided as furnished, with high-speed internet, a live-in professional staff member, and resident assistants included in the price.

Family housing is another popular option for students at Oregon State University, as many international students arrive with their families. The University can offer impartial advice on where to find suitable off-campus accommodation to any student who wishes to live in the surrounding area.

highlights.title: Sports
highlights.value: The Student Recreation Center has basketball courts, an indoor track, a swimming pool, weight and cardio rooms, a climbing wall, and lots more.

highlights.title: Library
highlights.value: Valley Library is the main library at Oregon State University. The institution has several libraries offering various computer services, books, journals, and more. The University has over 30 research centers and institutes covering environmental sciences, agriculture, marine biology, and more.
